parsed.note_claim: Europeans have been building bathhouses/steam baths for 1000s of years.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Iron Age saunas, unique to the Castro Culture of northwestern Iberia, have puzzled archaeologists since the nineteenth century. Initially interpreted as kilns, crematoriums, or ovens, their function has since been established as bathing structures
parsed.reason: The article confirms Iron Age Europeans in Iberia constructed and used sauna/bath structures over 2000 years ago, directly substantiating the note's claim about historical European bathing infrastructure.
